gameplay_mod_under_test: Ripples of the Past (unofficial NeoForge 1.21.1 port)
reported_symptom: synthetic mouse input accepted but no melee behaviour observable
diagnosis: Mouse delivery was never broken. InputEvent.MouseButton.Pre was published for every synthetic press; with a Stand summoned, the mod cancels it on purpose and suppresses the vanilla attack. Nothing in the bridge reported that, so a consumed input was indistinguishable from a lost one.

baseline_1_1_4.note: Same test as below on the released 1.1.4 jar, proving the mouse path already reached gameplay. mod_input_events is absent from 1.1.4 status, which is the reporting gap 1.1.5 closes.

block_break.input: world mouse button 0, press held then released

rotp_punch.input: world mouse button 0, press then release
rotp_punch.observed: Stand lunges into a punch and the left-mouse ability slot highlights in the ROTP power HUD
